caption:
Take practice tests at the hour you'll really test.

Test-day doors close at 8:00 a.m. and testing starts around 8:15 to 8:30. Start your weekend practice tests at 8:30 so that time feels normal.

Save this for your next practice test.
tiktok_caption: Take practice tests at the hour you'll really test: start at 8:30 a.m.

youtube.title: SAT Tip: Practice at the Same Time as Test Day
youtube.description: SAT testing starts around 8:15 to 8:30 a.m., so take your full practice tests on weekend mornings at that time.
